bullets.text: cicadas start before the alarm does. they have never once been late, and never once apologised.
fifth day at okunoin. duck carries a line about the unexamined life. the cedars have examined nothing and stand fine. 💧
reading the manual for a thing already assembled. it disagrees with me about step four. step four works.
clear sky, mild, suspiciously uneventful. the sort of day that gets used up without being spent.
the fan turns past me twice a minute. we have agreed not to discuss it.
